tasks.gr9-visual-arts-t2: Topic: Visual Arts. Cover design process and planning, research methods, South African and global artists, print techniques (linocut, relief), craft techniques (weaving, ceramics, batik), visual analysis, experimentation, and research documentation. Ask Grade 9 learners to explain design process steps, analyze artworks, identify artistic influences, describe print or craft methods, and justify choices from research.
tasks.gr9-music-t2: Topic: Music. Cover African and world music styles, listening analysis, harmony and chord progressions, texture and layering, ensemble balance, call-and-response forms, instrument recognition, and cultural music contexts. Ask Grade 9 learners to compare musical styles, identify instruments by ear, explain harmony structures, assess ensemble texture, and discuss cultural significance.
tasks.gr9-drama-t2: Topic: Drama. Cover South African theatre traditions, script interpretation, character motivation and development, voice and gesture control, stage directions, cultural awareness, and performance analysis. Ask Grade 9 learners to interpret scripts with cultural context, explain character choices, apply stage directions, discuss voice/gesture choices, and connect to social themes.
tasks.gr9-dance-t2: Topic: Dance. Cover social and cultural dance forms, choreographic intent and vision, canon and repetition devices, formation and spatial positioning, group patterns and coordination, cultural dance respect, and ensemble dynamics. Ask Grade 9 learners to identify dance traditions, explain choreographic choices, describe formations, assess ensemble coordination, and discuss cultural context.
